description: This file defines internal functions related to lazy tensor operations and metrics in the PyTorch framework, specifically for the torch._C._lazy module. It includes functions for synchronization, metrics, graph hashing, and IR cache management.

methods.name: _mark_step
methods.description: Marks a computational step for device synchronization, given device info and wait flag.

methods.name: _wait_device_ops
methods.description: Waits for device operations to complete for specified devices.

methods.name: _counter_names
methods.description: Returns a list of metric counter names.

methods.name: _counter_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific counter by name.

methods.name: _metrics_report
methods.description: Generates a report string of current metrics.

methods.name: _get_graph_hash
methods.description: Computes and returns a hash representing the graph structure of given tensors.

methods.name: _sync_multi
methods.description: Synchronizes multiple tensors across their devices, with optional wait and fallback controls.

methods.name: _get_tensor_id
methods.description: Retrieves a unique identifier for a given tensor.

methods.name: _get_tensors_text
methods.description: Returns a textual representation of a list of tensors.

methods.name: _get_tensors_dot
methods.description: Exports a visual graph (dot format) of tensors.

methods.name: _get_tensors_backend
methods.description: Returns backend information for a list of tensors.

methods.name: _get_force_fallback
methods.description: Retrieves the current fallback mode setting.

methods.name: _set_force_fallback
methods.description: Sets the fallback mode to a specified value.

methods.name: _clear_ir_cache
methods.description: Clears the intermediate representation cache used during lazy execution.

methods.name: _dump_ir_cache
methods.description: Dumps the IR cache to a specified filename.

methods.name: _set_reuse_ir
methods.description: Enables or disables reuse of IR across calls.

methods.name: _get_default_device_type
methods.description: Returns the default device type for tensors.
